Query:
WITH ranked AS (
      SELECT customer_id, days_since_last_purchase, customer_tenure_days, purchase_frequency_30d, purchase_frequency_90d, purchase_frequency_180d, avg_order_value, total_spend_90d, total_lifetime_value, avg_basket_size_6m, category_diversity_score, online_to_store_ratio, churn_label, loyalty_tier,
             is_deleted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
             ORDER BY event_time DESC, write_time DESC, api_invocation_time DESC) AS rn
      FROM "northstar_dev_customer_features_1792280809"
      WHERE event_time >= 1767225600.0 AND event_time < 1798761600.0
    ) SELECT customer_id, days_since_last_purchase, customer_tenure_days, purchase_frequency_30d, purchase_frequency_90d, purchase_frequency_180d, avg_order_value, total_spend_90d, total_lifetime_value, avg_basket_size_6m, category_diversity_score, online_to_store_ratio, churn_label, loyalty_tier
      FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND NOT is_deleted ORDER BY customer_id
